notes.title: I just made a demo for my new game. Interested?
notes.notes: [p]The creator of [i]The Monster Under Your Skin[/i] is ready to bring another idea to life. Welcome to the demo of [i]The Ripe Blood Anthology: This World Is Just for the Two of Us[/i]![/p][p]Love, slice-of-life, secrets, and... something unusual.[/p][p]In this new text-and-visual game you can influence the life of a police chief in a small town and uncover what [i]piranha-thoughts[/i] actually are.[/p][p]The demo is available here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2463560"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Nominate "The Monster Under Your Skin"!
notes.notes:
If you liked the plot of my game, then don't be lazy and nominate it for "Outstanding Story-Rich Game"!
Yes, it was a small adventure, but that doesn't mean it's not worthy=)
